pairs.evidence: app/api/route-capability-coverage.test.ts:241 The capability ratchet treats a route as gated if the raw file text contains a requireCapability*( token anywhere (src is the unstripped readFileSync at line 238, not split by verb), so a gate that appears only in a comment, or only on the GET of a file whose POST asks nothing, reads as compliant; its tenancy sibling strips comments first (route-tenancy-coverage.test.ts:51), and this one does not.

techniques.evidence: app/api/route-capability-coverage.test.ts:241 The presence assertion runs on raw text, with no comment or string stripping and no per-verb scoping, which is the exact 'prose satisfies the matcher' shape. The sibling scan does strip comments.

app/api/route-capability-coverage.test.ts:57 The house chain helper withCapability() (app/_lib/auth/route-guards.ts:78, used by analyze/cohort POST) produces the gated idiom, but the gate does not recognise it, and the refusal at line 254 never names it. A route gated only through the chain is refused.

app/api/route-tenancy-coverage.test.ts:203 A member-access call (store.fn() via a namespace import) or an aliased call is excluded by the lookbehind and passes silently. The escape form is not refused as a finding.

app/api/route-tenancy-coverage.test.ts:282 A seeded-failure fixture drives the real scanner over known offenders (route, helper, literal undefined) and over clean shapes. The population floor sits at line 242.
app/api/route-tenancy-coverage.test.ts:186 The keys come from the defaulted-tenant parameter in store source, not from a hand list, so renaming a store function cannot escape the scan.
app/api/route-tenancy-coverage.test.ts:229 Each ALLOWED entry is keyed by exact file::function and carries a reason. The capability twin deletes stale entries (line 243).

app/api/error-response-contract.test.ts:478 Growth fails the test through deepEqual. Slack below a ceiling is emitted as a diagnostic at line 483, so blocking and advisory are separated by construction.
